# Accounts (global)

> Claude Code accounts the user switches between. **They are all the same person** —
> a different account NEVER means a different user, and they all share this memory.
> Switched by exporting `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` before launching Claude Code.
> PRIVATE: logins live here and nowhere else. Never in a project tier.

## Registry

Regenerated by `memory-os accounts` from the `claude-accounts` registry. The `login` and
`purpose` columns are yours to fill and survive each sync. Don't edit the markers.

<!-- registry:start -->
| key | label | `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` | login | purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
<!-- registry:end -->

## What this means in practice

- The signed-in account email is NOT his identity. Never introduce him as, or address
  him by, the account's name. `me.md` is the only source of truth for who he is.
- Each account has its own config dir, so its own settings, history, and harness-level
  per-project memory. Those do NOT sync between accounts. memory-os does.
- Which account is active changes nothing about how to talk to him or what he prefers.
- Account-scoped facts (a login, a plan, an integration wired on only one) belong HERE,
  tagged with the account key — never in `me.md` or `preferences.md`.
- After adding an account, run `memory-os link` so it sees this store.
